quotes.text: Our family of 4, two adults and two teen, really enjoyed out Road to Hana tour. Our guide Scotty was awesome, he warned us when to get our cameras ready for pictures, told us all about the Hawaiian culture, history, plants and birds. We stopped to see waterfalls, Jurassic rock, rainbow trees, buy banana bread and the black sand beach. The comfort of the van was a wonderful way to see the road to Hana. When we stopped we had a fresh lunch of wraps, fruit and dessert.

Fabulous all day excursion! I was by myself and needed something to keep me occupied for the day. Ernie, our guide, was engaging and knowledgeable. The small group experience is so different than the big group tours and totally worth the price. The drive to Hana is long and letting someone else drive is by far the best decision you’ll make. The two provided meals were excellent. When you consider the price of food on the island this was a bonus. Take the tour!

We’re so glad we let Temptation Tours do the driving so we could relax and get to know Maui on the Road-to-Hana tour. Our friendly and entertaining guide, Ernie, was full of interesting information about all the plants and places we passed along the way. The sites were amazing, the rest stops were well planned, the meals were excellent, and the van was first class! Take this tour – you’ll be glad you did. – Marty S.

quotes.author: Robyn P
quotes.text: This was the absolute highlight of our trip. I have done the road to Hana many times and this is the absolute best way to see the island and get history.Our tour guide Scott made this trip! He is so knowledgeable and helped us capture some fantastic photos.It is absolutely worth the money, so if you’re even thinking about it, you should book it!!!!

Worth the price! The most memorable activity of my Maui trip. Starting with the small group size in a comfortable air-conditioned van. I got some great photos and videos at all our stops. A good mixture of nature views and scenic waterfalls and beaches. If you can request Gayle as your tour guide, do it! She is a phenomenal guide!

The best way to do the Road to Hana. Fly and Luxury-Limo Van. Gayle was wonderful even with losing everything in the Maui Fire, she was upbeat and spirit filled! The Helicopter was fantastic! This was worth every penny! #MauiStrong! We are so happy we did not cancel our trip to the Island!! -Trek
